items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1959-10-26
items.q: Just recently, I got a thing from Leonard Feather.

ctx.x: And I think possibly your best records are made on this side.

On this side. The Victor's got the best records and the Victor company, I asked them for permission to re-dub them records and they told me that they come from their legal department that they kept them in their vault. They called them some kind of record vault. And my hands was tied. I was going to take a chance and put them out myself to combat this propaganda that these other men were putting out. You see, they have an organization that make money at this thing called the Jazz Club. The very word they use is…
